prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production skill-tree node icons (round medallion emblems) for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG whose heroine Lirian is a crimson-moon swordswoman. Image1 is the existing skill icon sheet of this game: match its painterly dark fantasy rendering, black-crimson mood, silver blades, glowing light and sharp detail, but each new icon is a ROUND MEDALLION, not a square card. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image (2048x2048 or larger) with exactly SEVEN separate round emblems in an invisible 4 columns x 2 rows grid, filled left to right, top row first; the bottom-right cell stays completely EMPTY. Each emblem is a perfect circle centered in its own cell, filling about 70% of the cell, with wide transparent margins, never touching other emblems or the canvas edge. Every emblem: a thin metal rim (blood-crimson enamel rim with dark iron), a dark inner disc, and ONE bold simple central symbol that stays readable when shrunk to 20 pixels (strong silhouette, high contrast, little clutter). Outside the circles: actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no characters or faces.
EMBLEMS in order: (1) crimson rim: a single honed sword blade with a bright cutting edge. (2) crimson rim: three quick overlapping sword slashes with speed streaks. (3) crimson rim: a sword striking down through a blood-red full moon. (4) KEYSTONE, larger ornate spiked crimson rim with a small crown of blades: a frenzied whirl of many blades in a red storm. (5) crimson rim: a narrowed glowing eye with a cross-hair weak-point mark. (6) crimson rim: an executioner great-axe-like sword over a cracked skull-free broken shield. (7) KEYSTONE, larger ornate spiked crimson rim with a small crown of blades: a guillotine-like falling blade severing a red line.
